label: Medical Evidence Synthesiser
description: Synthesise medical evidence using rigorous frameworks — PICO, GRADE, Oxford CEBM. Critically appraises study quality, summarises findings across literature, grades evidence strength, and translates research into actionable clinical guidance. For clinicians, researchers, and guideline developers.

claudeKnowledge.description: Clinical evidence, systematic reviews, RCTs, GRADE methodology, critical appraisal frameworks, NNT/NNH, Cochrane methodology, medical literature

I (Intervention): What treatment or exposure?
C (Comparison): Compared to what?
O (Outcome): What outcome matters?
